summary: Implemented the window title feature without running tests or Black, as instructed. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a title tuple in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the formatter (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds set_window_title() beside show_cursor (returns True when written, False when not a terminal); rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches to term.set_title(title) with no other Windows calls; CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (tests/test_console.py, skipped on win32), test_control_title (tests/test_control.py), and test_control_set_window_title (tests/test_windows_renderer.py, Windows only). Nothing committed. Formatting was checked by eye for the 88-column limit, not by Black. Choices: the renderer test is named test_control_set_window_title to match the file's naming.
